definitions.explanation: The act of passing through a place without stopping, or successfully going through a process.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{関東|かんとう}{地方|ちほう}を{通過|つうか}した。
examples.english: The typhoon passed through the Kanto region.

examples.japanese: この{電車|でんしゃ}は{次|つぎ}の{駅|えき}を{通過|つうか}します。
examples.english: This train will pass through the next station without stopping.

examples.japanese: {法案|ほうあん}が{国会|こっかい}を{通過|つうか}した。
examples.english: The bill passed through the parliament.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜を{通過|つうか}する (to pass through ~)
・{通過|つうか}{点|てん} (passing point, waypoint)

HOMOPHONE:
・{通貨|つうか} (currency) - same reading, different meaning

COMMON USES:
・{審査|しんさ}を{通過|つうか}する (to pass screening/review)
・{税関|ぜいかん}を{通過|つうか}する (to pass through customs)
・{通過|つうか}{駅|えき} (station that a train passes through without stopping)
